content.short: Mantle Index Four Fund is an institutional crypto index fund tokenized through Securitize on Mantle.
content.description: Mantle Index Four Fund, also known as MI4, is an institutional-grade digital asset index product developed by Mantle with Securitize as tokenization partner. The fund is designed to provide diversified exposure to major crypto assets such as BTC, ETH, SOL, and USD stable or synthetic dollar components, while integrating yield strategies such as staking where appropriate. Tokenization through Securitize brings regulated fund administration, investor onboarding, and on-chain transferability for eligible participants. On Mantle, MI4 connects traditional fund structure with DeFi-native settlement and tokenized ownership.
